gen-gf-knewave-fs-rowan: Bold, marker-drawn Knewave has tight, nearly shut letterforms, while Rowan opens every curve wide and friendly beneath it. Make the Rowan body text a touch larger and it stays easy to take in over a short read.
gen-gf-konkhmer-sleokchher-fs-paquito: Paquito keeps its lowercase close to cap height, steady and approachable. Under Konkhmer Sleokchher's tall, showy waist line it would tire over a long page, so it fits best in brief bursts.
gen-gf-koulen-fs-paquito: Blunt, squeezed and paperclip-bent, Koulen shouts first. Paquito then talks low and friendly, its small gap between lowercase and caps making a few lines feel compact and sure, though not for pages.
gen-gf-kristi-fs-bespoke-sans: Kristi writes like a quick pen on paper, with open curves that swell gently and a modulation you notice only up close. And Bespoke Sans sharpens things below it, leaving generous space where curves meet stems, so short stretches read crisp.
gen-gf-lacquer-fs-rowan: Commanding Lacquer flares its curves outward with a sturdy, low-contrast heft, and Rowan below it tapers its strokes softly like a candle flame. Brief copy is where it feels at home.
gen-gf-lakki-reddy-fs-amulya: Amulya keeps its curve gaps generous and its manner modern, a plain sans with no fuss. And Lakki Reddy's stencil-cut hand lettering looks livelier beside it; make the heading small and that charm fades.
gen-gf-lakki-reddy-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, leaving wide space between its curve ends and stems, which suits a few lines nicely. Lakki Reddy brings the sturdy hand-drawn warmth; the plain sans brings polish.
gen-gf-lakki-reddy-fs-chillax: Lakki Reddy has a relaxed hand-drawn look, with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, like letterpress. But Chillax has spaghetti-like, pen-lifted curves with unfinished loops, so over long paragraphs it gets tiring.
gen-gf-lakki-reddy-fs-gambetta: Lakki Reddy has a relaxed, hand-drawn feel, with a mild letterpress thickness shift and a wide-open curve. And Gambetta's bookish text serif answers it with graceful, noticeably varied strokes, a pairing that sits warmly together.
gen-gf-lakki-reddy-fs-plein: Lakki Reddy's soft modulation looks like hand-drawn ink lines, relaxed and personal. Plein follows with a clear channel into every round letter, reliable but better in brief bursts than long paragraphs.
